JSManagedValue.doc: A JavaScript value with conditional retain behavior to provide automatic memory management.

JSVirtualMachine.doc: A self-contained environment for JavaScript execution.

JSExport.doc: The protocol for exporting Objective-C objects to JavaScript.

JSType.doc: Constants that identify the type of a JavaScript value.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates a JavaScript type with the specified raw value.

rawValue.doc: The raw value that represents the JavaScript type.

JSTypedArrayType.doc: The type of a JavaScript typed array object.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates a typed array with the specified raw value.

rawValue.doc: The raw value that represents the typed array’s type.

JSClassDefinition.doc: A structure that contains properties and callbacks that define a type of object.

+currentArguments.doc: Returns the arguments to the current native callback from JavaScript code.

+currentCallee.doc: Returns the currently executing JavaScript function.

+currentContext.doc: Returns the context currently executing JavaScript code.

+currentThis.doc: Returns the value of the this keyword in currently executing JavaScript code.

-evaluateScript:withSourceURL:.doc: Executes the specified JavaScript code, treating the specified URL as its source location.

-initWithVirtualMachine:.doc: Creates a new JavaScript context associated with a specific virtual machine.

-objectForKeyedSubscript:.doc: Returns the value of the specified JavaScript property in the context’s global object, allowing subscript getter syntax.

-setObject:forKeyedSubscript:.doc: Sets the specified JavaScript property of the context’s global object, allowing subscript setter syntax.

+managedValueWithValue:.doc: Creates a managed value with the specified JavaScript value.

+managedValueWithValue:andOwner:.doc: Creates a managed value and associates it with an owner.

-initWithValue:.doc: Initializes a managed value with the specified JavaScript value.

+valueWithBool:inContext:.doc: Creates a JavaScript representation of the specified Boolean value.

+valueWithDouble:inContext:.doc: Creates a JavaScript representation of the specified floating-point value.

+valueWithInt32:inContext:.doc: Creates a JavaScript representation of the specified signed integer value.

+valueWithNewArrayInContext:.doc: Creates a new, empty JavaScript array value.

+valueWithNewErrorFromMessage:inContext:.doc: Creates a JavaScript error value with the specified error message.

+valueWithNewObjectInContext:.doc: Creates a new, empty JavaScript object value.

+valueWithNewPromiseInContext:fromExecut.doc: Creates a promise object using the specified executor callback.

+valueWithNewPromiseRejectedWithReason:i.doc: Creates a rejected promise object with the specified value.

+valueWithNewPromiseResolvedWithResult:i.doc: Creates a resolved promise object with the specified value.

+valueWithNewRegularExpressionFromPatter.doc: Creates a JavaScript regular expression value from the specified pattern.

+valueWithObject:inContext:.doc: Creates a JavaScript value by converting the specified native object.

+valueWithUInt32:inContext:.doc: Creates a JavaScript representation of the specified unsigned integer value.

-callWithArguments:.doc: Invokes the value as a JavaScript function.

-constructWithArguments:.doc: Invokes the value as a JavaScript constructor.

-defineProperty:descriptor:.doc: Defines a property on the JavaScript object value or modifies a property’s definition.

-deleteProperty:.doc: Deletes the named property from the JavaScript object value.

-hasProperty:.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the JavaScript value has a defined property with the specified name.

-invokeMethod:withArguments:.doc: Calls the named JavaScript method on the value.

-isEqualToObject:.doc: Compares the value to another for strict equality.

-isEqualWithTypeCoercionToObject:.doc: Compares the value to another for equivalence, allowing type conversion.

-isInstanceOf:.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the value is an instance of another JavaScript object value.

-objectAtIndexedSubscript:.doc: Returns the value’s JavaScript property at the specified index, allowing subscript syntax.

-objectForKeyedSubscript:.doc: Returns the value’s JavaScript property named with the specified key, allowing subscript syntax.

-setObject:atIndexedSubscript:.doc: Sets the value’s JavaScript property at the specified index, allowing subscript syntax.

-setObject:forKeyedSubscript:.doc: Sets the value’s JavaScript property named with the specified key, allowing subscript syntax.

-setValue:atIndex:.doc: Sets the value at the specified numeric index in the JavaScript object value.

-setValue:forProperty:.doc: Sets the value of the named property in the JavaScript object value.

-toArray.doc: Converts the JavaScript value to an array.

-toBool.doc: Converts the JavaScript value to a native Boolean value.

-toDate.doc: Converts the JavaScript value to a date object.

-toDictionary.doc: Converts the JavaScript value to a dictionary.

-toDouble.doc: Converts the JavaScript value to a native floating-point value.

-toInt32.doc: Converts the JavaScript value to a native signed integer value.

-toNumber.doc: Converts the JavaScript value to a NSNumber object.

-toObject.doc: Converts the JavaScript value to a native object.

-toObjectOfClass:.doc: Converts the JavaScript value to a native object of the specified class.

-toPoint.doc: Converts the value to a point structure.

-toRange.doc: Converts the value to a range.

-toRect.doc: Converts the value to a rectangle structure.

-toSize.doc: Converts the value to a size.

-toString.doc: Converts the JavaScript value to a native string.

-toUInt32.doc: Converts the JavaScript value to a native unsigned integer value.

-valueAtIndex:.doc: Returns the value at the specified numeric index in the JavaScript object value.

-valueForProperty:.doc: Returns the value of the named property in the JavaScript object value.

-addManagedReference:withOwner:.doc: Notifies the JavaScriptCore virtual machine of an external object relationship.

-removeManagedReference:withOwner:.doc: Notifies the JavaScriptCore virtual machine that a previously registered object relationship no longer exists.

JSGlobalContextRef.doc: Returns the C representation of the JavaScript context.

exception.doc: A JavaScript exception to be thrown in evaluation of the script.

exceptionHandler.doc: A block to be invoked should evaluating a script result in a JavaScript exception being thrown.

globalObject.doc: The JavaScript global object associated with the context.

init(JSGlobalContextRef:).doc: Creates a JavaScript context object from the equivalent C representation.

inspectable.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether you can inspect the JavaScript context with Safari Web Inspector.

name.doc: A descriptive name for the context.

virtualMachine.doc: The JavaScript virtual machine to which the context belongs.

value.doc: The managed value’s underlying JavaScript value.

JSValueRef.doc: Returns the C representation of the JavaScript value.

context.doc: The JavaScript context hosting this value.

init(JSValueRef:inContext:).doc: Creates a JavaScript value object from the equivalent C representation.

init(point:inContext:).doc: Creates a JavaScript representation of the specified point.

init(range:inContext:).doc: Creates a JavaScript representation of the specified range.

init(rect:inContext:).doc: Creates a JavaScript representation of the specified rectangle.

init(size:inContext:).doc: Creates a JavaScript representation of the specified width and height.

isArray.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the instance is a JavaScript array value.

isBoolean.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the instance is a JavaScript Boolean value.

isDate.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the instance is a JavaScript Date object.

isNull.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the instance corresponds to the JavaScript null value.

isNumber.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the instance is a JavaScript numeric value.

isObject.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the instance is a JavaScript object.

isString.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the instance is a JavaScript String object.

isSymbol.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the instance is a symbol.

isUndefined.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the instance corresponds to the JavaScript undefined value.
